description: This file defines a REST API class for managing report schedules in the Superset application, including CRUD operations, bulk delete, and fetching Slack channels, with detailed route and schema configurations.

classes.name: ReportScheduleRestApi
classes.description: API class for managing report schedules, including CRUD operations, bulk delete, and Slack channel retrieval, with route and permission configurations.

methods.name: ensure_alert_reports_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the ALERT_REPORTS feature is enabled; returns 404 response if not.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a report schedule by ID, handling errors and responses.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates a new report schedule from JSON request data, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates an existing report schedule identified by ID, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: bulk_delete
methods.description: Performs bulk deletion of report schedules based on provided IDs.
